digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III, App. VI, main text

teaser.en: A milky-sapped liana with hook-like tendrils, whose flexible but strong stems go into furniture.
teaser.sw: Mtambaa wenye utomvu mweupe kama maziwa na vikonyo vyenye umbo la kulabu, ambao mashina yake yanayopindika lakini imara hutumika kutengeneza samani.

summary.en: Mbohoya is a woody liana related to the rubber vines, with white latex, hooked tendrils and round orange fruits. Pakia names it among the climbers whose flexible but strong stems are used for crafts, mostly furniture.
summary.sw: Mbohoya ni mtambaa wenye shina la mti, wa jamii moja na mipira (rubber vines), wenye utomvu mweupe, vikonyo vyenye umbo la kulabu na matunda ya mviringo ya rangi ya machungwa. Pakia anautaja miongoni mwa mitambaa ambayo mashina yake yanayopindika lakini imara hutumika katika ufundi, hasa samani.

about.en: Mbohoya is a woody climber that runs with white milky latex when cut. Its leaves are glossy and opposite. It climbs by curled, hook-like tendrils, which are modified flower stalks. Clusters of small, fragrant white flowers are followed by round fruits that ripen yellow to orange. Like its relatives, the rubber vines, the fruit has a juicy pulp around the seeds. Digo people identify it by its leaves, fruits and stem together.
about.sw: Mbohoya ni mtambaa wenye shina la mti ambao hutoa utomvu mweupe kama maziwa ukikatwa. Majani yake yanang'aa na hukaa kwa jozi zinazotazamana. Hupanda kwa kutumia vikonyo vilivyojikunja kama kulabu, ambavyo ni vikonyo vya maua vilivyobadilika umbo. Vishada vya maua madogo meupe yenye harufu nzuri hufuatwa na matunda ya mviringo yanayoiva yakawa ya manjano hadi machungwa. Kama ilivyo kwa jamaa zake, mipira, tunda lake lina nyama yenye maji mengi inayozunguka mbegu. Wadigo huutambua kwa kuangalia majani, matunda na shina lake kwa pamoja.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest, thicket and bushland, climbing into shrubs and trees.
where.sw: Hukua katika misitu ya pwani, vichaka na nyika ya vichaka, ukipanda juu ya vichaka na miti.

uses.en: Pakia names *mbohoya* with *muungo* (*Saba comorensis*) and *mpira* (*Landolphia kirkii*) as typical *mbugu*, lianas, whose wood is 'flexible but strong' and therefore used in crafts, mostly furniture. Elsewhere in East and southern Africa its ripe fruits are eaten.
uses.sw: Pakia anautaja *mbohoya* pamoja na *muungo* (*Saba comorensis*) na *mpira* (*Landolphia kirkii*) kama mifano ya *mbugu*, yaani mitambaa, ambayo mbao zake 'zinapindika lakini ni imara' na kwa hiyo hutumika katika ufundi, hasa samani. Kwingineko Afrika Mashariki na kusini mwa Afrika matunda yake yaliyoiva huliwa.

culture.en: In Pakia's account of Digo life forms, *mbugu* are lianas and climbers that twine or scramble and must have a woody stem. *Mbohoya* is one of his model examples.
culture.sw: Katika maelezo ya Pakia kuhusu maumbo ya maisha ya mimea kwa Kidigo, *mbugu* ni mitambaa na mimea inayojiviringa au kutambaa na ni lazima iwe na shina la mti. *Mbohoya* ni mojawapo ya mifano yake ya kielelezo.

names.en: Digo: *mbohoya*. Pakia records it only for Digo, gives no meaning, and records no English or Swahili name.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mbohoya*. Pakia analirekodi kwa Kidigo tu, hatoi maana yake, wala harekodi jina la Kiingereza au Kiswahili.

reason.en: Saba comorensis, named with it for furniture-making
reason.sw: Saba comorensis (mbungo), unaotajwa pamoja nao kwa kutengeneza samani

reason.en: Landolphia kirkii, a rubber vine used the same way
reason.sw: Landolphia kirkii (mpira), mtambaa wa mpira unaotumika kwa namna hiyo hiyo

reason.en: Another milky-sapped liana of the same family
reason.sw: Mtambaa mwingine wenye utomvu kama maziwa wa familia hiyo hiyo

reason.en: Hunteria, another latex-bearing member of the family
reason.sw: Hunteria, mmea mwingine wa familia hii wenye utomvu
